promises.label: FY27 revenue growth guidance revised
promises.quote: we have changed our revenue growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% Y-on-Y growth in constant currency terms
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: FY27 operating margin guidance 20-22%
promises.quote: Margin guidance is maintained at 20% to 22%
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: 6,000 frontier engineers over next few years
promises.quote: Our plan is to have 6,000 frontier engineers over the next few years
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: Salary hikes effective October and January '27
promises.quote: We plan to give salary hikes to most of our employees effective October while the rest of the employees will be covered in January '27
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Tax rate 29-30% for the year
promises.quote: We expect effective tax rate for the year to be in the range of 29% to 30%
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Onsite mix reduction 75bps-1% for year
promises.quote: We expect Onsite mix excluding new acquisitions to reduce by 75 bps to 1% for the year
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: CEO transition: mentee 6 months, term ends Mar 2027
promises.quote: his term is coming to an end on March 31, 2027... for 6 months, he will work as a mentee under Salil's leadership
